name: videogen
description: Connect VideoGen to Fractal through its MCP server and access the operations exposed to the connected account.

interface.shortDescription: Use VideoGen MCP tools from your Fractal workspace.
interface.longDescription: Connect VideoGen to your Fractal workspace so your agent can work with aI video creation using the tools exposed by the service. Available actions depend on the live MCP server and the connected account’s permissions.
defaultPrompt: Give me an overview of my VideoGen workspace.
Find anything in VideoGen that needs attention and explain why.
Help me review aI video creation in VideoGen.
